subtitle: Markdown drafts with reviewed GitHub saves
description: Write Markdown with the Rinx article writer layout, icon controls and preview in a compatible OctoSense host. Keep recoverable drafts locally; connect GitHub through host OAuth, select a repository and file, and review exact Markdown before committing. Requires the connected-services host build. Live OAuth and remote commits remain unverified; screenshots show fictional native UI fixtures. Optional Ask GitHub Notes requires separate agent consent and can send questions, conversation context and permitted repository/file read results to your configured model. No agent write or approval tools are exposed; manual editing works without a model.
release_notes: 0.1.1: explicitly declare the optional foreground read-only assistant and its account/data instructions. Preserve the three private, non-shareable read tools. Editor, reviewed GitHub save path and original screenshots are unchanged; no new live-provider claim.
